criteria.text: `pdd test --screen` on a 400 by 400 page with a visible `#search-box` region, visible "Search" heading and an unreferenced `.sr-only` HTML label styled with `clip-path: inset(50%)`, `clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0)` on `position: absolute`, or both exits with code 0 and marks `#search-box` and "Search" as `pass`.

When the `.ui.svg` drawing requires a visible "Search query" label that exists on the page only inside a fully clipped `.sr-only` HTML element, `pdd test --screen` exits with code 1, marks "Search query" as `hidden` and sets `passed` to `false`.

When a page element uses partial or unestablished clipping such as `clip-path: inset(49%)`, `clip-path: circle(0)`, non-empty `clip: rect(0px, 1px, 1px, 0px)` or `clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0)` on `position: static`, `pdd test --screen` exits with code 5 and prints the unsupported clipping error to stderr.

When a page element combines a collapsed clip with `filter` or `mask-image`, or when a `.ui.svg` drawing or Simulator Screen host or shell ancestor uses `clip-path` or `clip`, `pdd test --screen` rejects it with the existing error instead of passing.

400x400 page with Tailwind/Bootstrap .sr-only rule combining clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) and clip-path: inset(50%)

drawing requires visible 'Search query' inside #search-box, but page only has 'Search query' inside fully clipped .sr-only label
